data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, **I'd recommend Stripe or Shopify Payments for most businesses**\. The best choice depends mainly on what platform your store runs on, how much you sell, and whether you sell locally or internationally.

Here are the main contenders I'd compare\:

## Best payment processors for a UK online store

![CPGIO - Multichannel eCommerce Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/PjgYNLsLO5kyHaLbRGf_vEGDklf86yBgljtBg18t7Dvw-WgJwtAR87t17RVnZQNRleNsnU2jfdTsx-hJkwGMn58MvL69dhGg6Mz4413HP_F8ItDmZVpm38tgVXpxLOBbHgVAgnhtZKjtJgc5PKyPg4Dx8NXHfNqw_93O-hccPsS0BrwP9sqrs9aaI_I6CV7n?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- UK card fees: approximately 1.5% + 20p
- No monthly fee on standard pricing
- Excellent fraud protection and integrations
- Supports subscriptions and international payments

Best for WooCommerce, custom websites and independent online stores.

[Stripe website](https://stripe.com/gb)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Integrated directly into Shopify
- No separate third-party transaction surcharge
- Easy refunds, reporting and reconciliation
- Pricing depends on your Shopify plan

Best if your store already runs on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments website](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Square**

- Online UK card fees: approximately 1.4% + 25p
- Free entry-level plan
- Online and in-person payments
- Straightforward setup

Best if you sell online and at markets, events or a physical shop.

[Square website](https://squareup.com/gb/en)

---

![PayPal Review: Is It the Right Payment Solution for You?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Tb4l2sAZiezYqSwWI257xsR6Xu0StrpvRBfglhUmoX3ym_BKZCv57DPk0af1Bp6xi5ybj92wq6prLOQZ307hFyJz2zbjdBN1HYy64DdJYUxgA51W2YSY0pG7XDgLKYG9Y_6a9G9miy6Oqt5DjWtXQyteBeRgO2-fjh76KKoiZnmx1ygYUuHA2W6jRY5_Ji16?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal**

- Familiar to many online shoppers
- Supports PayPal wallet and card payments
- Useful additional checkout option
- Standard online fees can be relatively high

Best as an additional payment method rather than necessarily your main processor.

[PayPal Business website](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

Indicative UK pricing as of November 2026. Actual rates vary by card type, plan and transaction circumstances. [www.businessexpert.co.uk](https://www.businessexpert.co.uk/payment-processing/best-online-payment-solutions/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[whito.co.uk](https://whito.co.uk/tools/best-payment-processors-for-uk-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.intelivita.co.uk](https://www.intelivita.co.uk/blog/best-online-payment-gateways?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

For most small online shops, I'd start with\:

- **Main processor\:** Stripe, or Shopify Payments if using Shopify.
- **Additional checkout option\:** PayPal.
- **As you grow\:** Negotiate processing rates based on your transaction volume.

## Three questions to narrow it down

I can recommend the most cost-effective option if I know\:

**1\. What platform does your store use?**

---

**2\. What's your approximate monthly sales revenue?**

---

**3\. Where are most of your customers?**

I can then compare actual processing costs and help you avoid paying unnecessary transaction fees as your store grows.
